title: Corrosive Wave
description: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
smart_description: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
notes: Removed at the end of the player's turn. The power tracks the number of times a card is drawn (Counter stack type). Applies Poison to all hittable enemies whenever the player draws a card, including cards drawn from hand draws and other sources.
